title: Bose-Einstein thermal operators for semidefinite optimization
summary: We establish that semidefinite programs (SDPs) over the unbounded positive semidefinite cone are mathematically equivalent to thermodynamic systems of independent bosonic modes: the eigenvalues of the optimization variable play the role of expected occupation numbers, the linear objective plays the role of total expected energy, and the linear equality constraints play the role of conserved non-commuting charges.
